runs.note: 0 retries; bot escapes by road, so no boat bonus

motorRequests.change: In update(): replace `const p = e.a; if (p.seat || p === P) continue;` with `const p = e.a; if (p === P) continue; if (p.seat) { if (!p.dead) p.ride(); continue; }`.
motorRequests.why: A seated mission ped is never stepped, so its body stays where it got in while the vehicle drives on. traffic.js rides its crews; mission actors don't. As a result m.deliver of a passenger never completes, and hits and draws use the old spot. G2 works around this with an op that calls ride() on Nana every step.

motorRequests.change: Add a first line to _arm(): `if (this.thrown && this.ped.throwing) return this.thrown;`. In attack()'s molotov/grenade branch, keep the aim but replace the unconditional `I.tap.attack = true; this.throwT = ...` with `if (!p.throwing && p.inv.cool <= 0) { I.tap.attack = true; this.throwT = THROW_EVERY * (.8 + .4 * this._r()); }`.
motorRequests.why: Fighters never throw. select() adds .25 s to inv.cool, so the one tap on the switching step fires nothing. throwT is reset anyway and the gun is selected again on the next step, and ped.js only steps a throw while the thrown weapon is in hand. Measured with scratchpad molotov.mjs: three 5000-hp rat-grunts carrying Party Starters at 153-264 u threw 0 in 40 s, and their rounds stayed {mag 5, total 5}. PLAN 9.3 arms the Rats with Molotovs; G3's Rats carry Snubs instead.

motorRequests.change: In the _goto() spray branch, replace `I.down.fire = true; I.down.attack = true;` with `const ws = p.inv.spec(), auto = !ws || ws.rate >= 6; I.down.fire = true; I.down.attack = auto || (this.t * 4 | 0) % 2 === 0; I.tap.attack = !auto && I.down.attack;`.
motorRequests.why: ped.js throws only on I.tap.attack and swings only on taps, so a spray hint (button held) can never throw a Party Starter or swing a bat. It only works with automatic weapons, which is why G3's bot torches the drums with the Hot Mess.

motorRequests.change: In _fight()'s vehicle-melee branch, before `if (bd > 10) return F._go(dt, I, t.x, t.y, true, 'car' + t.id);`, add `if (bd > 40) { F.path = null; return this._go(dt, p, t.x, t.y, { foot: true, stay: true, radius: 8 }, w); }`.
motorRequests.why: The Fighter's _go paths to the sidewalk node nearest the car and re-plans to that same node when something is in the way. In an early G1 the bot stood against a lamp post for the rest of the timer, and a stale path flip-flopped between two cars. G1's hint works around it: a foot goto until the bot is within 10 u (box distance), then kill.

motorRequests.change: Remember the last body to hurt the player (BUS 'hit' with target === player id: { by, t }). In update(), on foot: if that body is an alive crowd ped (ped.crowd, no gang, not police) within 30 u that hit in the last 2 s, `return this._fight(dt, p, foe, w)` before following the hint.
motorRequests.why: A passer-by the bot's swing clips fights back (crowd.js sends a whole skater troupe), and the bot keeps walking to its next target. In G1 seed 3, Gus went from 100 health + 100 armor to 0 in 20 s (scratchpad g1-s3-fight.log). G1 works around it by making such a ped and its troupe flee (crowd member brain.react('flee', { force: true })).

motorRequests.change: In _board(): time the boarding of one vehicle (this.boardT, reset when boardFor changes, += dt). After about 12 s still not seated: `this.auto.tried.add(v.id); this.car = null; this.boardFor = null;` and pick another vehicle.
motorRequests.why: In an early G2 (3 stars, on foot) the bot sat in AutoPlayer state 'board' on one spot from 110 s to 400 s of game, seen by the Eye throughout (scratchpad g2-lose-s2.log).

motorRequests.change: In _evade() and _far(): while police.heli is up, prefer destinations under cover (under the Loop or L decks), and leave lanes within about 120 u of police.blocks out of the route.
motorRequests.why: The bot cannot lose 3 stars: the Eye sees 520 u except under decks, and roadblocks laid 620-760 u ahead on its route stopped it. G2's early designs failed every seed; G2 now draws the Eye off at the drop-off (3 to 2 stars).

motorRequests.change: Change m.wanted.clear from `w.floor(0); w.cap(5); w.clear('mission');` to `w.clear('mission'); w.floor(0); w.cap(5);`.
motorRequests.why: Lifting the cap before the heat is gone re-stars for a moment: at G1's hide-out a 'wanted' event went 1 to 2, then 2 to 0 (scratchpad g1-s2-probe3.log). Patrols react to that event. G1 and G3 call m.wanted.set(0) before clear() to avoid it.

motorRequests.change: In addLot(): when a pier or quay lot is laid over water, make its cells ground for the lots after it. Add `if (overWater && taken[i] === 1) taken[i] = 0;` in the rect callback. Alternatively, in content, add onWater: true to those building lots in landmarks.js.
motorRequests.why: A building lot over water is skipped cell by cell (`taken[i] === 1 && !overWater && !lot.onWater`). So the Harbor Rats Boathouse and the Lighthouse are in city.lots but have no walls and no roof: map.cell is 0 across the boathouse (scratchpad boathouse.mjs). G3 burns the boathouse's pier instead.

motorRequests.change: Add m.kill(tag, { done: a => bool }): a predicate for when a target counts (default: dead, wrecked, out or burning), used by the op's count and by the bot's alive filter.
motorRequests.why: G1 counts a car smashed once it smokes by setting the vehicle's `out` flag from a 'hit' listener, because kill and the bot only read out, wrecked and burning.

motorRequests.change: Add MissionContext calls so content needn't reach into m.W: `get hour()` (W.clock.hour); `blast(at, { damage, splash, fire })` (W.combat.explosives.blast with by: null, plus fire.add); `shoo(ped)` (a crowd ped and its troupe flee); and a truce(gang) under which kills of that gang's city members cost no respect while the mission runs. This generalises the Rats' requests 7 and 8.
motorRequests.why: G2 reads m.W.clock.hour. G3 calls m.W.combat.explosives.blast for its drums and refunds respect via m.W.life.gangs.add. G1 calls crowd member brains through m.W.life.crowd.
